main_text.p: lute largiter olim effusum, impuri sordidéque, ori admovemus?
main_text.head: CAP. II. De Definitione Eucharistiæ.
main_text.p: 1EUcharistiam describimus, quòd sit Sacramentum Novi Testamenti, in quo è Christi institutione mediante pane & vino corpus Christi pro nobis traditum, & sanguis ejus pro nobis effusus in remissionem peccatorum, manducandum & bibendum in commemorationem ejus nobis offertur & exhibetur.

2Ac 1. Sacramentum N. Testamenti est: Est enim duorum Novi Testamenti Sacramentorum à Christo nobis commendatorum Sacramentum alterum, docente Augustino Epist. 118. Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum, sicut ipse in Evangelio loquitur, leni iugo suo nos subdidisse & sarcinæ levi: unde de Sacramentis numero paucissimis, observatione facilimis, significatione præstantissimis, societatem novi populi colligavit, sicuti est Baptismus Trinitatis nomine confecta

page.notes: Right-hand page is largely show-through and cut off at the edge; the printed marginal letters of the right page were not transcribed. Several words in the left-margin note numbers and in italic passages are doubtful; the text beside the woodcut-style initial E is read as printed. Some words are blurred by show-through (e.g. "remissionem", "offertur", "confecta") and may be imperfect.
